source_description_html:
The true pleasure of riding begins where limitations end. The X-904 Ultra Carbon was engineered for riders who refuse to compromise between the raw, high-speed protection of a racing helmet and the plush, long-distance comfort of a premium tourer. From endless highway stretches to the tightest mountain switchbacks, this full-face flagship from our XSeries range delivers a precise, uncompromising solution to the real-world demands of the open road.

Elite Performance Meets Endurance Comfort:

Featherlight Ultra Carbon Shell: By utilizing a high-content carbon fiber weave, the X-904 UC delivers maximum impact resistance with minimal weight. This incredible balance drastically reduces head inertia and neck fatigue, ensuring effortless aerodynamic stability even when pushing high speeds.

Carbon Fitting X-Series Lining: Far more than simple padding. The interior liner features active carbon filaments that naturally regulate temperature, control static electricity, and promote breathability. Fully adjustable and anatomically contoured, it creates a tailored fit that entirely eliminates pressure points on long-distance journeys.

Panoramic 224° x 90° Field of View: True active safety through vision. The ultra-wide eyeport provides an expansive panoramic view, allowing you to check your dashboard at a glance and track obstacles in your periphery without unnecessary head movements.

Seamless N-Com (Sena) Integration: Stay safely connected. Fully certified to the strict ECE 22-06 standard, the helmet features dedicated internal styling for N-Com communication systems. The installation blends flawlessly into the shell, maintaining the helmet's clean aerodynamics and quiet acoustics.

All-Weather Climate Management: Built to conquer changing climates. A high-performance ventilation network is paired with an adjustable VPS sunshield to block sudden glare. When the weather turns, premium window seals and the included Pinlock® fog-resistant lens ensure crystal-clear visibility.


Defy the distance. The X-904 Ultra Carbon brings track-ready engineering, absolute refinement, and iconic Italian craftsmanship to the modern sport-tourer.

  • SAFETY

    • Homologation: UN/ ECE 22-06 (other homologation
    available - depending region)
    • Ultra-carbon shell to achieve better protection at low
    weight
    • Crash sensor (Quin) to give emergency alert and key
    safety data in case of accident (on dedicated model –
    “Quin”)
    • Ultrawide flat and scratch resistant visor offering
    unequal field of vision
    • Adjustable (5 positions) Vision Protection System
    sunscreen (VPS) - UV protection up to 400nm with
    emergency recall command
    • Integrated LED to increase visibility in case of poor
    visibility condition or emergency break (on dedicated
    model – “I-ESS”)
    • Multi-density EPS (expended Polystyrene) for impact
    energy absorption in different condition of temperature,
    speed (high & low) and type of surface
    • Specific EPS per size for optimum ratio fit/cushion
    (maximum EPS for every size)
    • NERS – Nolan Emergency Release System , the helmet
    can be safely detached in emergency situations
    • D-rings retention system

  • COMFORT & FIT

    • Ventilation: adjustable air intakes on top and on
    mouthpiece with direct air flow to head coupled with
    rear extractor at the back to evacuate warm air
    • Mesh fabric in top inner cap to facilitate air flow
    • Soft premium polyamide fabric interwoven with carbon
    Fibers to provide thermo-regulation and fast dry
    • Regular fit: pressure distribution for better performance
    • LAF-Liner Adjustable Fitting: customizable top cap
    padding (3 thickness) in 4 area
    • Steady fit: 3D shaped cheek pads with removable
    padding (3 thickness - spare parts)
    • Premium Italian Sakura polyamide fabric on cheek pads
    for comfort and durability in abrasive area
    • EA – Eyewear adaptative to ease the usage of glasses

  • PERFORMANCE

    • Ready for and certificated for N-Com Bluetooth+ and N-Com MeshTM
    • Fog resistant inner visor to guarantee clear visibility in
    any condition
    • Tinted visors and mirror available for different light
    conditions (spare part)
    • Wind protector and breath deflector
    • Weight: 1500g +/- 50 (puro black - no accessories -
    size M- ECE 22-06)
    • Made in Italy: design, developed and produced in
    Brembate di Sopra, BG

source_description_html:
The true pleasure of riding begins where limitations end. The X-904 Ultra Carbon was engineered for riders who refuse to compromise between the raw, high-speed protection of a racing helmet and the plush, long-distance comfort of a premium tourer. From endless highway stretches to the tightest mountain switchbacks, this full-face flagship from our XSeries range delivers a precise, uncompromising solution to the real-world demands of the open road.

Elite Performance Meets Endurance Comfort:

Featherlight Ultra Carbon Shell: By utilizing a high-content carbon fiber weave, the X-904 UC delivers maximum impact resistance with minimal weight. This incredible balance drastically reduces head inertia and neck fatigue, ensuring effortless aerodynamic stability even when pushing high speeds.

Carbon Fitting X-Series Lining: Far more than simple padding. The interior liner features active carbon filaments that naturally regulate temperature, control static electricity, and promote breathability. Fully adjustable and anatomically contoured, it creates a tailored fit that entirely eliminates pressure points on long-distance journeys.

Panoramic 224° x 90° Field of View: True active safety through vision. The ultra-wide eyeport provides an expansive panoramic view, allowing you to check your dashboard at a glance and track obstacles in your periphery without unnecessary head movements.

Seamless N-Com (Sena) Integration: Stay safely connected. Fully certified to the strict ECE 22-06 standard, the helmet features dedicated internal styling for N-Com communication systems. The installation blends flawlessly into the shell, maintaining the helmet's clean aerodynamics and quiet acoustics.

All-Weather Climate Management: Built to conquer changing climates. A high-performance ventilation network is paired with an adjustable VPS sunshield to block sudden glare. When the weather turns, premium window seals and the included Pinlock® fog-resistant lens ensure crystal-clear visibility.


Defy the distance. The X-904 Ultra Carbon brings track-ready engineering, absolute refinement, and iconic Italian craftsmanship to the modern sport-tourer.

    • Homologation: UN/ ECE 22-06 (other homologation
    available - depending region)
    • Ultra-carbon shell to achieve better protection at low
    weight
    • Crash sensor (Quin) to give emergency alert and key
    safety data in case of accident (on dedicated model –
    “Quin”)
    • Ultrawide flat and scratch resistant visor offering
    unequal field of vision
    • Adjustable (5 positions) Vision Protection System
    sunscreen (VPS) - UV protection up to 400nm with
    emergency recall command
    • Integrated LED to increase visibility in case of poor
    visibility condition or emergency break (on dedicated
    model – “I-ESS”)
    • Multi-density EPS (expended Polystyrene) for impact
    energy absorption in different condition of temperature,
    speed (high & low) and type of surface

    (maximum EPS for every size)
    • NERS – Nolan Emergency Release System , the helmet
    can be safely detached in emergency situations
    • D-rings retention system

    • Ventilation: adjustable air intakes on top and on
    mouthpiece with direct air flow to head coupled with
    rear extractor at the back to evacuate warm air
    • Mesh fabric in top inner cap to facilitate air flow
    • Soft premium polyamide fabric interwoven with carbon
    Fibers to provide thermo-regulation and fast dry
    • Regular fit: pressure distribution for better performance

    padding (3 thickness) in 4 area

    for comfort and durability in abrasive area

source_description_html:
Premium safety shouldn’t be out of reach. The Nolan N60-6 is our benchmark full-face helmet, engineered for the new generation of riders and daily commuters who refuse to compromise on protection or style. Serving as the perfect entry point to the Nolan world, this versatile helmet is built to conquer everything from stop-and-go city traffic to weekend highway stretches with effortless ease.

Bulletproof Lexan™ Shell: Ride with absolute confidence. Built entirely from premium Lexan™—the most impact-resistant polycarbonate on the market—the N60-6 delivers top-tier structural safety that easily meets the strict ECE 22-06 standards.

All-Weather Climate Control: Stay fresh through hot summer commutes. The exclusive Airbooster Technology upper ventilation system forces cool air directly across the top of your head, ensuring optimal airflow and temperature management when the heat is on.

Oversized Panoramic Vision: Take in the whole environment. The ultra-wide, scratch-resistant visor maximizes your peripheral vision for safer lane changes in heavy traffic, and comes pre-equipped with an included Pinlock® fog-resistant lens.

Instant VPS Sunscreen Protection: Adapt to changing light seamlessly. The internal drop-down VPS sunscreen features an adjustable design to protect your eyes from sudden blinding glare, making sunset rides or dark tunnels easy to handle.

Eco-Friendly Comfort Liner: Designed with the planet in mind. The interior features sustainable, eco-friendly fabric padding that is highly breathable, moisture-wicking, and incredibly soft against the skin for all-day riding comfort.

  • SAFETY

    • Homologation UN/ ECE 22-06 (other homologation available - depending region)
    • Durable Lexan™ polycarbonate shell is engineered to effectively absorb impact energy, helping to reduce the force transmitted to the rider’s head
    • Compatible with ESS III high visibility in case of low light situations or braking warning
    • Ultrawide and scratch resistant visor offering unequal field of vision
    • Adjustable (multiple position) Vision Protection System sunscreen (VPS) - UV protection up to 400nm
    • Multi-density EPS (expended Polystyrene) for impact energy absorption in different condition of temperature, speed (high & low) and type of surface
    • Specific EPS per size for optimum ratio fit/cushion (maximum quantity EPS for every size)
    • Microlock retention system for easy, precise and quick helmet fastening

  • COMFORT & FIT

    • Adjustable “AirBooster Technology” with large front air intakes (top and mouthpiece) and large back extractor for optimum ventilation
    • Innovative open mesh construction headset liner to offer extra ventilation on top of the head
    • Soft Italian polyamide recycled fabric inner liner ally durability, softness and breathability
    • Soft Italian polyester fabric on cheek pad for durability in abrasive areas
    • Cheek pads with removable internal padding (washable without the padding)
    • EA – Eyewear adaptative to ease the usage of glasses

  • PERFORMANCE

    • Fog resistant inner visor to guarantee clear visibility in any condition
    • Tinted and mirror visors available for different light conditions (spare part)
    • Wind protector (ready for)
    • Weight: 1400g +/- 50 (Classico Nero – size M – ECE 22- 06)
    • Made in Italy: design, developed and produced in Brembate di Sopra, BG

source_description_html:
Premium safety shouldn’t be out of reach. The Nolan N60-6 is our benchmark full-face helmet, engineered for the new generation of riders and daily commuters who refuse to compromise on protection or style. Serving as the perfect entry point to the Nolan world, this versatile helmet is built to conquer everything from stop-and-go city traffic to weekend highway stretches with effortless ease.

Bulletproof Lexan™ Shell: Ride with absolute confidence. Built entirely from premium Lexan™—the most impact-resistant polycarbonate on the market—the N60-6 delivers top-tier structural safety that easily meets the strict ECE 22-06 standards.

All-Weather Climate Control: Stay fresh through hot summer commutes. The exclusive Airbooster Technology upper ventilation system forces cool air directly across the top of your head, ensuring optimal airflow and temperature management when the heat is on.

Oversized Panoramic Vision: Take in the whole environment. The ultra-wide, scratch-resistant visor maximizes your peripheral vision for safer lane changes in heavy traffic, and comes pre-equipped with an included Pinlock® fog-resistant lens.

Instant VPS Sunscreen Protection: Adapt to changing light seamlessly. The internal drop-down VPS sunscreen features an adjustable design to protect your eyes from sudden blinding glare, making sunset rides or dark tunnels easy to handle.

Eco-Friendly Comfort Liner: Designed with the planet in mind. The interior features sustainable, eco-friendly fabric padding that is highly breathable, moisture-wicking, and incredibly soft against the skin for all-day riding comfort.

  • SAFETY

    • Homologation UN/ ECE 22-06 (other homologation available - depending region)
    • Durable Lexan™ polycarbonate shell is engineered to effectively absorb impact energy, helping to reduce the force transmitted to the rider’s head
    • Compatible with ESS III high visibility in case of low light situations or braking warning
    • Ultrawide and scratch resistant visor offering unequal field of vision
    • Adjustable (multiple position) Vision Protection System sunscreen (VPS) - UV protection up to 400nm
    • Multi-density EPS (expended Polystyrene) for impact energy absorption in different condition of temperature, speed (high & low) and type of surface
    • Specific EPS per size for optimum ratio fit/cushion (maximum quantity EPS for every size)
    • Microlock retention system for easy, precise and quick helmet fastening

  • COMFORT & FIT

    • Adjustable “AirBooster Technology” with large front air intakes (top and mouthpiece) and large back extractor for optimum ventilation
    • Innovative open mesh construction headset liner to offer extra ventilation on top of the head
    • Soft Italian polyamide recycled fabric inner liner ally durability, softness and breathability
    • Soft Italian polyester fabric on cheek pad for durability in abrasive areas
    • Cheek pads with removable internal padding (washable without the padding)
    • EA – Eyewear adaptative to ease the usage of glasses

  • PERFORMANCE

    • Fog resistant inner visor to guarantee clear visibility in any condition
    • Tinted and mirror visors available for different light conditions (spare part)
    • Wind protector (ready for)
    • Weight: 1400g +/- 50 (Classico Nero – size M – ECE 22- 06)
    • Made in Italy: design, developed and produced in Brembate di Sopra, BG

source_description_html:
Turn heads and conquer the curves. The Nolan N60-6 Sport takes our highly popular full-face road helmet and injects it with a bold, racetrack-inspired identity. Engineered for sport riders, naked-bike enthusiasts, and those who live for the thrill of winding roads, this helmet makes a powerful statement. It combines aggressive racing aesthetics with the smart, functional features you need to rule the daily streets.

Track-Ready Styling, Street-Smart Engineering:

Aerodynamic Rear Spoiler: The signature feature of the Sport edition. The large, wind-tunnel-tested rear spoiler radically enhances aerodynamic stability at high speeds, minimizing helmet buffeting and neck fatigue on fast straights.

Aggressive Visual Identity: Beyond its sharp lines, the N60-6 Sport stands out with high-octane graphics and dynamic colorways specifically designed to express your personality and get you noticed on the blacktop.

Oversized Panoramic Vision: Never lose sight of the apex. The ultra-wide, scratch-resistant visor provides an expansive field of view for maximum situational awareness, and comes ready to lock in the included Pinlock® fog-resistant lens.

Evolved Ventilation & Eco-Comfort: Push your limits while staying perfectly cool. An advanced multi-point ventilation network forces fresh air throughout the shell, while the interior features sustainable, eco-friendly fabric padding that feels premium against the skin and controls moisture.

Integrated VPS Sunscreen: Ready for changing light. The internal VPS sun visor drops down instantly to eliminate sudden blinding glare, making the transition from bright open roads to shady canopies completely seamless.

  • SAFETY

    • Homologation UN/ ECE 22-06 (other homologation available - depending region)
    • Durable Lexan™ polycarbonate shell is engineered to effectively absorb impact energy, helping to reduce the force transmitted to the rider’s head
    • Compatible with ESS III high visibility in case of low light condiction or braking warning
    • Ultrawide flat and scratch resistant visor offering unequal field of vision
    • Adjustable (multiple positions) Vision Protection System sunscreen (VPS) - UV protection up to 400nm
    • Multi-density EPS (expended Polystyrene) for impact energy absorption in different conditions of temperature, speed (high & low) and type of surface
    • Specific EPS per size for optimum ratio fit/cushion (maximum quantity EPS for every size)
    • Microlock retention system for easy, precise and quick helmet fastening

  • COMFORT & FIT

    • Adjustable “AirBooster Technology” with large front air intakes (top and mouthpiece) and large back extractor for optimum ventilation
    • Innovative open mesh construction headset liner to offer extra ventilation on top of the head
    • Soft Italian polyamide recycled fabric inner liner ally durability, softness and breathability
    • Soft Italian polyester fabric on cheek pad for durability in abrasive areas
    • Cheek pads with removable internal padding (washable without the padding)
    • EA – Eyewear adaptative to ease the usage of glasses

  • PERFORMANCE

    • Aerodynamic Spoiler (non removable)
    • Fog resistant inner visor to guarantee clear visibility in any condition
    • Tinted and mirror visors available for different light conditions (spare part)
    • Wind protector (in the box)
    • Weight: 1470g +/- 50 (Classico Nero – size M – ECE 22- 06)
    • Made in Italy: design, developed and produced in Brembate di Sopra, BG

source_description_html:
The union between a brand capable of combining style and sportiness such as Nolan and a tough rider with a strong and combative character such as Andrea Iannone has given life to this unique helmet: N60-S SPORT REPLICA IANNONE. Each graphic line on the shell is a symbol of a deep transformation, which reflects Andrea's present, built with ambition and dedication. A clear message that lies behind the image of the phoenix combined with the phrase « LIKE A PHOENIX I RISE FROM THE ASHES »: an invitation to never stop, continuing to feed ourselves at every moment with the fire that burns inside each of us. Sporty Soul and Street Heart define this version, dedicated to motorcyclists with a sporty spirit but for more road use, an everyday helmet. It is the interpretation of the smartest full-face helmet, designed by Nolan technicians and designers with everyday use in mind, but also to express your passion for riding on a ride around mountain hairpin bends or on the curves of the lake, or simply for free time. In the REPLICA IANNONE version, the main image, namely the phoenix and the colours that animate it, as well as all the details, are offered in a matt finish: from the graphics applied on the matt black Lexan polycarbonate shell to the rear spoiler, which is transparent smoke grey with matt inserts. Completing this REPLICA version, the race number 29 is shown on the rear matt shell (under the spoiler), where the words « LIKE A PHOENIX I RISE FROM THE ASHES » are also included. Available from the end of July.

  • SAFETY

    • Homologation UN/ ECE 22-06 (other homologation available - depending region)
    • Durable Lexan™ polycarbonate shell is engineered to effectively absorb impact energy, helping to reduce the force transmitted to the rider’s head
    • Compatible with ESS III high visibility in case of low light condiction or braking warning
    • Ultrawide flat and scratch resistant visor offering unequal field of vision
    • Adjustable (multiple positions) Vision Protection System sunscreen (VPS) - UV protection up to 400nm
    • Multi-density EPS (expended Polystyrene) for impact energy absorption in different conditions of temperature, speed (high & low) and type of surface
    • Specific EPS per size for optimum ratio fit/cushion (maximum quantity EPS for every size)
    • Microlock retention system for easy, precise and quick helmet fastening

  • COMFORT & FIT

    • Adjustable “AirBooster Technology” with large front air intakes (top and mouthpiece) and large back extractor for optimum ventilation
    • Innovative open mesh construction headset liner to offer extra ventilation on top of the head
    • Soft Italian polyamide recycled fabric inner liner ally durability, softness and breathability
    • Soft Italian polyester fabric on cheek pad for durability in abrasive areas
    • Cheek pads with removable internal padding (washable without the padding)
    • EA – Eyewear adaptative to ease the usage of glasses

  • PERFORMANCE

    • Aerodynamic Spoiler (non removable)
    • Fog resistant inner visor to guarantee clear visibility in any condition
    • Tinted and mirror visors available for different light conditions (spare part)
    • Wind protector (in the box)
    • Weight: 1470g +/- 50 (Classico Nero – size M – ECE 22- 06)
    • Made in Italy: design, developed and produced in Brembate di Sopra, BG

Three great classics for the Nolan N80-8 full-face: Grey in a glossy finish, White in a metallic finish and Black in a matt version. Colours that do not follow fashions and are appreciated for their evergreen attitude. Place-less and timeless, suitable for every type of outfit. Nolan's research even on the most classic single-colours focused on creating paints and effects that were not taken for granted but aimed at maximum quality. And even the interiors have been updated in the selection of new fabrics, now proposed in Kent grey, to match the shell.

  • SECURITY

    • Homologation UN/ ECE 22-06 (Other homologation available - depending region)
    • Durable Lexan™ polycarbonate shell is engineered to effectively absorb impact energy, helping to reduce the force transmitted to the rider’s head
    • Compatible with ESS III high visibility in case of low light conditions or braking warning
    • Ultrawide and scratch resistant visor offering unequal field of vision
    • Adjustable (4 positions) Vision Protection System sunscreen (VPS) - UV protection up to 400nm with emergency recall command
    • Multi-density EPS (expended Polystyrene) for impact energy absorption in different conditions of temperature, speed (high & low) and type of surface
    • Specific EPS per size for optimum ratio fit/cushion (maximum quantity EPS for every size)
    • NERS – Nolan Emergency Release System , the helmet can be safely detached in emergency situations
    • Microlock2 retention system for easy, precise and quick helmet fastening

  • COMFORT & FIT

    • Adjustable “AirBooster Technology” with large front air intakes (top and chinguard) and large back extractor for optimum ventilation
    • Innovative open mesh construction headset liner to offer extra ventilation on top of the head
    • Soft Italian polyamide recycled fabric inner liner ally durability, softness and breathability
    • Soft Italian polyester fabric on cheek pad for durability in abrasive areas
    • Liner Positioning Control (LPC): Liner adjustable in multiple position for precise fit
    • Cheek pads with removable internal padding (washable without the padding)
    • EA – Eyewear adaptative to ease the usage of glasses

  • PERFORMANCE

    • Ready for and certified with N-Com Bluetooth+ and N-Com MeshTM (and R series)
    • Fog resistant inner visor to guarantee clear visibility in any condition
    • Tinted and mirror visors available for different light conditions (spare part)
    • Visor mechanism with tilting functionality for better sealing
    • Wind protector (in the box)
    • Weight: 1590g +/- 50 (Classico Nero – size M – ECE 22- 06)
    • Made in Italy: design, developed and produced in Brembate di Sopra, BG

Structural Carbon Fiber Strength: The high-content carbon fiber shell construction radically reduces weight while maintaining maximum energy-absorption and integrity under severe impact.

Safety-Lock Visor System: Built for extreme conditions. A heavy-duty, central visor locking mechanism prevents the shield from accidentally blasting open during high-speed slides or severe impacts, keeping your face completely protected.

The D.O.C. graphic proposal is expressed through two main blocks, protagonists of the shell, with the upper section highlighting the carbon fibre and the lower section represented by a colour. Separating them is a horizontal, sinuous line running along the helmet's aerodynamic and compact shape. The result is a contemporary and modern effect. In its essentiality, D.O.C. represents a form of graphic application that enhances the lines of the helmet and defines a new style devoted to racing. A world that Nolan today defines with the term ‘speeding’. There are two variants for D.O.C.: Carbon / White and Carbon / Impulse Green. The spoilers are painted to ensure a sense of aesthetic continuity. The interior of the helmet has been renewed by proposing a neutral colour, a sand nuance, which leaves the design of the shell as the protagonist.

The union between a brand capable of combining style and sportiness such as Nolan and a tough rider with a strong and combative character such as Andrea Iannone has given life to this unique helmet: X-804 RS UC REPLICA IANNONE. Each graphic line on the shell is a symbol of a deep transformation, which reflects Andrea's present, built with ambition and dedication. A clear message that lies behind the image of the phoenix combined with the phrase « LIKE A PHOENIX I RISE FROM THE ASHES »: an invitation to never stop, continuing to feed ourselves at every moment with the fire that burns inside each of us. Fiber and character are the two cornerstones of this version, very similar to the original worn by the racer, made on the basis of the top of the range Speeding full-face fiber helmet, customized with exclusive graphic details: the applied graphics, with the iridescent colors red, orange, yellow and white, alternate on the shell with parts of black carbon fiber also visible and shiny parts, giving the helmet an even more aggressive and sporty personality. The red that envelops the phoenix, spreads across the entire upper part of the shell, extending up to the attachment of the spoiler where the graphics continue to the extreme back of the helmet, taking up the Nolan logo and the XSeries writing, to identify the fiber helmets of the collection. Finally, Iannone's race number 29 is shown on the shiny rear shell (under the spoiler), where the words « LIKE A PHOENIX I RISE FROM THE ASHES » are also highlighted. The REPLICA helmet is completed by the shiny air vents.
